scenes.title: ASD-STE100
scenes.subtitle: Simplified Technical English
scenes.narration: ASD dash STE one hundred means Simplified Technical English.

scenes.title: What is it?
scenes.text: A specification for writing technical documentation that anyone — in any language — can understand. Born in aerospace maintenance, used far beyond it.
scenes.narration: A specification for writing technical documentation that anyone, anywhere, can understand.

scenes.title: Writing rules
scenes.narration: Writing rules: short sentences, one idea each, active voice, everyday words.

scenes.title: The dictionary
bullets: Approved words only — checked, one meaning
No slang, no jargon, no ambiguity
scenes.callout: One word = one meaning. "Start" is approved; "begin" is not.
scenes.narration: The dictionary: approved words only. One word, one meaning. Start, not begin.

scenes.title: What you get
scenes.narration: Clear for non-native readers, fewer mistakes, easier translation.

scenes.title: Simple words.
scenes.subtitle: That is ASD-STE100 — Simplified Technical English
scenes.narration: Simple words, clear docs. Learn more at ASD-STE100 dot org.
